capabilities: capture memos from the ribbon, command palette or a global shortcut
organize memos with search, nested tags, pinning, archiving and batch actions
store memos as Markdown in a custom folder with monthly, quarterly or yearly files
restore deleted memos from the plugin trash
optionally send memo context to an AI API or local Codex for answers
extras: Install requires manually downloading main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from releases into the plugins folder; it is not a standard community-store install. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. AI is off by default, and when enabled selected memo content is sent to the chosen provider.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in fast memo-style inbox for jotting thoughts with search, tags, pinning, archiving and trash in one panel.

relations.evidence: Added Text Reference integration. Install and enable Text Reference 0.14.0 or later, then turn on the integration

summary: Quick-capture memo space that stores ideas, everyday notes and tasks as plain Markdown files inside the vault.
